out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at BOTH RESTROOM HANDWASHING SINKS AND THE HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO THE THREE- VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP AND PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at WOMEN’S RESTROOM HANDWASHING SINK AND HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. SOAP WAS ADDED DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP AND PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SALSA AT 50F AND SHREDDED CHEESE AT 52F AT THE BACK WALL 2-DOOR PREP-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOODS TO THE WALK-IN COOLER AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL STORED ON A SHELF IN THE BACK OF THE ESTABLISHMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC REMOVED PEST CONTROL DURING INSPECTION AND PROVIDED PROOF TO THE EHS THAT THE ESTABLISHMENT RECEIVES COMMERCIAL PEST CONTROL TREATMENTS. PLEASE ENSURE RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL IS NEVER USED IN THE ESTABLISHMENT. BIG BITE PIZZA (Inspection Date: 10/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN THAWING IN A BOX ON THE FLOOR OUTSIDE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PIC MOVED CHICKEN INSIDE COOLER.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED A DEAD MOTH AND ANOTHER DEAD INSECT ON THE STEAMER IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC CLEANED AND SANITIZED THE STEAM TABLE CONTAINER. PIC PROVIDED EHS WITH MOST RECENT PEST CONTROL INVOICE. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH ANOTHER PEST CONTROL INVOICE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE BACK WALL TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP COOLER AT 54F WITH EHS THERMOMETER; OBSERVED BOTTOM PORTION OF THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP AT 60F (RAIL AT 41F).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED TCS FOODS FROM TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP AND THE BOTTOM PORTION OF THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP WAS NOT IN USE AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE TWO-DOOR PREP TOP AND BOTTOM PORTION OF THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP IS NOT USED UNTIL THEY CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED THE EXTERIOR AND INTERIOR OF MOST REFRIGERATION UNITS (INCLUDING THE WALK-IN COOLER AND WALK-IN FREEZER) ARE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND ON A MORE FREQUENT BASIS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED CUT BLEACH JUGS USED AS FUNNELS AT EVERY PIPE COMING FROM EACH COMPARTMENT AT THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE INSTALL TRUE FUNNELS FOR ALL PIPING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook line being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink by the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC REPLACED SOAP.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken and beef stored over vegetables and ready to eat foods in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REARRANGED WALK IN COOLER PLACING RAW MEAT ON THE BOTTOM.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED CHEMICALS LIKE BLEACH STORED WITH FOOD AND SINGLE SERVICE CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED FOOD AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC PURCHASED A FOOD THERMOMETER
